title: Short-Run Multi-Outcome Effects of Nightlife Regulation in San Juan
abstract: arXiv:2510.25782v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: I evaluate San Juan, Puerto Rico's late-night alcohol sales ordinance using a multi-outcome synthetic control that pools economic and public-safety series. I show that a common-weight estimator clarifies mechanisms under low-rank outcome structure. I find economically meaningful reallocations in targeted sectors -- restaurants and bars, gasoline and convenience, and hospitality employment -- while late-night public disorder arrests and violent crime show no clear departures from pre-policy trends. The short post-policy window and small donor pool limit statistical power; joint conformal and permutation tests do not reject the null at conventional thresholds. I therefore emphasize effect magnitudes, temporal persistence, and pre-trend fit over formal significance. Code and diagnostics are available for replication.

translated_title: 圣胡安夜间娱乐管制政策的短期多结果效应
translated_abstract: 我采用一种汇集经济与公共安全时间序列的多结果合成控制方法，评估了波多黎各圣胡安的深夜酒类销售条例。我证明，在低秩结果结构下，共同权重估计器能够厘清政策的作用机制。研究发现，目标行业——餐馆和酒吧、汽油与便利店以及酒店业就业——出现了具有经济意义的资源重新配置，而深夜公共秩序逮捕和暴力犯罪则未显示出明显偏离政策前趋势的迹象。由于政策实施后的观察窗口较短且供体池规模较小，统计功效受到限制；联合保形检验和置换检验在常规显著性阈值下均无法拒绝原假设。因此，本文更强调效应量级、时间持续性以及政策前趋势拟合程度，而非形式上的统计显著性。代码和诊断结果可供复现使用。
tldr: 本文利用多结果合成控制法评估波多黎各圣胡安深夜酒类销售禁令，发现该政策对餐馆酒吧、汽油便利店和酒店业就业产生了显著的经济再配置效应，但对深夜治安逮捕和暴力犯罪没有明显影响。
en_tdlr: Using a multi-outcome synthetic control approach, this study finds that San Juan's late-night alcohol sales ordinance generated economically meaningful reallocations in targeted sectors (restaurants and bars, gasoline and convenience, hospitality employment), while showing no clear effects on late-night public disorder arrests or violent crime.
